title: Sign-up form
content:
Join Larkspur Supply Co.. A one-time $30 lifetime membership.

Form fields:
- Full name (required)
- Email (required)
- Password (required, at least 12 characters)
- Phone (optional)
- Interests (choose any): Hiking, Paddling, Climbing, Winter travel
- Newsletter: "Send me the monthly newsletter" (checkbox)
- Agreement: "I agree to the member terms" (required checkbox; the terms link to /terms)

Button: Join and pay $30.
Below the form: Already a member? Sign in (/sign-in).
